text: ENDORSED BYDominic Rapini2022 Republican Secretary of the State candidate"As a former CTGOP candidate for Secretary of the State, I’ve seen firsthand the qualities required to serve as Connecticut’s chief elections officer. I’ve known Peter Lumaj for six years, and I’ve never met a more principled, committed conservative — a man whose love for the United States and for Connecticut is matched by his deep understanding of what it means to live without freedom. As someone who escaped a communist regime, Peter brings a rare and powerful perspective to this role, grounded in gratitude for democracy and a fierce defense of our republic. I wholeheartedly endorse Peter Lumaj for Secretary of the State of Connecticut."View all endorsements →
